summary: 日更 job 具备 token 保护和云端 timer 发布配置；DashScope 临时图片只允许逐跳阿里云 HTTPS 重定向并落盘为受限 asset key。

green_test.adapter: DashScope Qwen-Image 3.0 async endpoint uses X-DashScope-Async and task polling; download redirects are manually validated per hop
green_test.local_regression: npm run test:article, npm run lint and npx tsc --noEmit passed after adapter hardening

runtime: The deploy pipeline creates CONTENT_JOB_TOKEN remotely when absent, installs/enables foodtracker-content.timer, and checks timer enabled/active after restart.
red_line: No provider key is exposed to the client; no temporary provider URL is stored in the database; job route rejects missing or mismatched bearer tokens.
